title: Class maps and proof certificates
objective: Implement abstract class-group presentation/maps, ideal discrete logarithms, principality witnesses, GRH proof labels, unconditional Minkowski proof records, and mutation tests

handoff.summary: Adds a CPython-parseable IdealClassGroup with Sage-compatible invariant coordinates, exact ideal maps and principality witnesses, plus independently replayable GRH and unconditional Minkowski evidence. The engine adapter now rejects placeholder saturation labels: it embeds the authenticated sagejs.number-fields/class-unit-saturation-v1 producer wrapper, retains nontrivial p-saturation primes and initial index bound, and delegates every replay to result.verify_saturation_record(payload). Unconditional payloads additionally embed authenticated MinkowskiProofProgress, require complete strided partition coverage, bind relations/presentation/generators/saturation hashes, bind wrapped records to exact public ideal-log witnesses, and reject incomplete resumable progress or reauthenticated coverage corruption.
risks: The adapter applies to relation-engine results that retain an exact presentation and ideal discrete-log witnesses; specialized legacy results without ideal maps deliberately remain on their existing fallback surface.
Independent unconditional replay regenerates every prime ideal through the certified Minkowski bound, so verification cost is proportional to that proof bound.

General engine results must now expose the coordinated saturation_record, verify_saturation_record(payload), proof_progress, and four proof_dependency_hashes surfaces; integration must merge core commit 1cfc0340 and the matching engine producer together with this adapter.
The broad pnpm test:baselib:strict and pnpm test:native contract gates were deferred to central integration by coordinator direction; focused compiled and standalone strict-Pyright receipts pass.
next_steps: Merge core MinkowskiProofProgress commit 1cfc0340 and the matching engine saturation/partition producer before exercising the public adapter.
Add an integration smoke test around one completed and one resumed general Buchmann--Hecke engine result once engine and map lanes are merged.
Run the broad strict/native and four-platform gates after all class/unit lanes are merged, then move this contract from active to review if lane policy requires those receipts.
